svg.title: Suspension and emulsion polymerisation set-ups
svg.desc: Left: stirred reactor with large monomer droplets stabilised by PVA in water, each droplet a tiny bulk reactor giving polymer beads. Right: reactor with surfactant micelles holding monomer, large monomer droplets as reservoirs and growing latex particles.
svg.text: Monomer droplets 0.05–2 mm, each holding oil-soluble initiator:
every droplet is a tiny bulk reactor
Product: beads (PS, PVC, PMMA, resins) – filter, wash, dry
Monomer droplets (1–10 µm) = reservoirs; micelles ≈ 5 nm hold monomer
Latex particles 50–500 nm: SBR, PVAc, PVC paste, acrylics
High M and fast rate together (radicals kept apart)
Large plain circle = monomer droplet; small circle with tails = surfactant micelle; solid green = growing particle
